column1: # Blocks asked of the Konoha build session (tools/konoha/blocks.json is theirs). Furniture blocks come from the
# catalogue's block= props and are listed in data/items/block_requests.json with them; this table describes the
# shop-interior and station blocks that are not furniture you can buy. kind: interior (decor that may need a
# state or a seat), station (opens a crafting screen), display (shows items or a wardrobe outfit; needs a block
# entity). vf: a Village Friends block reused as it is.

column3: description
A waist-high wooden shop counter, straight and corner shapes; the keeper stands behind it and right-clicking it opens the shop screen
A short split curtain over a shop door, in the shop's colour with its name painted (a variant per shop)
A wall board of wooden menu slats; shows the shop's price list on right-click
Ichiraku's long bar counter with a raised serving ledge; dishes sit on it (VF tavern table rules)
A round-topped stool that faces the counter; a VF Seat for residents and the player
The broth pots, noodle board and steam behind Ichiraku's counter (decor, animated steam)
Tilted wooden crates showing their produce (cabbage, daikon, rice sacks)
A stack of open crates showing what is for sale
Stacked straw rice sacks
Free-standing shelves showing up to six stocked items
A wall of small cubbies for sundries: shows up to nine items
An open stall: a trestle table under an awning, for Market Day and the fish stall
A tray of crushed ice showing the day's fish
A charcoal grill with dango skewers, smoking
A bench draped in red cloth under a parasol; a Seat
A tall red paper parasol (wagasa)
A low tea-house counter with a kettle on a brazier
A table with a sunken grill; a squad sits round it (Seats on both sides)
A plain bench seat for booths; a Seat
A pegboard wall showing kunai, shuriken and blades for sale
A glass-topped display case showing up to four items
The weapon shop's forge hearth and bellows: the smithy station's heat, glows while working
A Japanese block anvil with hammers: the smithy station's screen opens here
A water trough beside the forge; hisses when a blade is quenched
A pedal grindstone: sharpening and repair at the smithy
A rail of hooks showing pouches and holsters
A wall of scroll cubbies showing technique scrolls for sale
A low case showing one featured scroll open
The scroll shop's low desk with ink stone and seal plates: the public sealing desk
Tiered buckets of cut flowers by season
Stepped shelves of potted plants for sale
A table with shears and wrapping paper for bouquets
A low platform that shows one furniture piece as it would stand in a home
A lectern with the furniture shop's catalogue: order pieces not on the floor
A rack of planks and logs at the Kinoshita yard
A pair of sawhorses with a half-cut board
Shelves of cloth bolts in the tailor's palettes
A tailor's mannequin that wears one wardrobe outfit (shows the outfit for sale on the resident model)
A folding screen to change behind: try an outfit on before buying
A counter behind wooden bars with a small window; the pawn shop's screen opens here
A crowded shelf of odd things for sale
The bath house's raised front desk
Wooden shoe and clothes lockers
A low wooden stool and bucket at the washing area; a Seat
A wall of a hundred small medicine drawers (hyakumi-dansu)
Bamboo racks of drying herbs
The dispensary's counter window
A tall bookshelf showing books and novels for sale
A table of new books laid flat
A ninken kennel with a gate; pups for adoption wait here
A veterinary table
Shelves of kibble, collars and toys
A rack of steel bars, wire spools and chain
The shrine's charm counter showing omamori
The wish-plaque rack; hangs the plaques players write
Strings for tying bad fortunes
A slatted offering box with a bell rope above it: the shrine offering service
A rack of pigment jars and brushes
A charcoal grill pressing rice crackers
Shelves of glass jars of crackers
A festival yatai: a wheeled stall with a lantern-hung roof
A shallow tub of goldfish for the scooping game
A target-throwing game: three shuriken, painted targets
The prize shelf at a festival game
VF's painter workstation, reused for the painters' studio
A small display stand that shows one keepsake on a table, shelf or the floor
A wooden wall bracket that shows one item (a blade, a mask, a curio): home display furniture
A barber's chair facing a mirror; a Seat. Right-click with the barber present opens the restyle screen
